en.title: Prefixes
en.summary: A prefix is added to the beginning of a word to change its meaning.

paragraphs: A prefix is a group of letters placed at the beginning of a word. It changes the meaning, and sometimes the word class, of the original word. English has many prefixes, taken from English, Latin and Greek. Learning the common ones helps you understand many new words.

blocks.html:
PrefixMeaningExamples
un-not, oppositeunhappy, unlock, unfair
in- / im- / il- / ir-notincorrect, impossible, illegal, irregular
dis-not, oppositedislike, disagree, disappear
non-notnonsense, non-stop
mis-wronglymisunderstand, mislead

PrefixMeaningExamples
re-againrewrite, rebuild, return
pre-beforepreview, prepare, prehistoric
post-afterpostpone, postwar
over- / under-too much / too littleoverwork, underpaid
sub- / super-under / abovesubway, supermarket
inter-betweeninternational, interview
co-togethercooperate, co-worker
anti-againstantisocial, anti-war
semi- / mini-half / smallsemicircle, minibus

paragraphs: A prefix does not change the spelling of the base word: un + necessary = unnecessary; dis + appear = disappear. A hyphen is used before a capital letter (anti-American), with some prefixes (ex-wife, self-service) and to avoid confusing combinations (re-cover and recover).

There is no rule that tells which negative prefix goes with which word, so you have to learn them with the word: unable but impossible, dishonest but incorrect. Before p or b, in- becomes im-; before l it becomes il-; before r it becomes ir-.

items: Wrong: **a pre-war's house** Right: **a pre-war house**

ro.title: Prefixele
ro.summary: Un prefix este un grup de litere adăugat la începutul unui cuvânt pentru a forma un cuvânt nou.

paragraphs: Prefixul se pune la începutul unui cuvânt de bază. El modifică sensul cuvântului de bază. Cu ajutorul prefixelor putem forma ușor cuvinte noi.

Prefixul se lipește direct de cuvânt, fără spațiu. Prefixul «ne-» arată o lipsă sau o negație. Prefixul «re-» arată repetarea unei acțiuni. Prefixul «des-» devine «dez-» înaintea unei vocale sau a unei consoane sonore.

blocks.html:
PrefixSensExemplu
ne-negație sau opussigur → nesigur
re-repetarea acțiuniia face → a reface
des- / dez-acțiune inversăa lega → a dezlega
stră-vechi sau îndepărtatbunic → străbunic
